lines.t: The snow falls soft like whispered prayers
Covering the pain I used to wear
The world stands still, but you still move
Through the silence, I'm renewed
I was lost in a storm of my own design
Frozen heart running out of time
But you melted through the frost and fear
Now your mercy draws me near
Frozen grace
Falling all around me
Every flake
A sign you found me
In the cold, you're warm for me
Peace like fire through my veins
Frozen grace breaking through the ice
You bring the dead to life
The wind may howl, but I won't fall
Your voice still whispers through it all
Forgiveness shines through crystal skies
You've made this heart alive
Every tear turns into light
Every shadow fades from sight
You are the dawn in my longest night
Forever, I am yours
Frozen grace, falling all around me
Every flake, a sign you found me
In the cold, you're a warn for manes
Peace like fire through my veins
Frozen grace, my heart set free
Heaven's love now lives in me
Thank you.
